searchText: MSRP $109,441. New Brinkley 5th Wheel for sale - 2026 Brinkley Model Z 2680 is approximately 29' 11' in length with 1 slide. Features Dual Pane Windows Curt TCS Upgraded Suspension Integrity Package Power Package Insulation Package Queen Bed More About This RV You'll love every minute spent in this spacious fifth wheel that can sleep four each night. There is a front private bedroom with a queen bed and 4x under-bed drawers to keep your space tidy. Your guests can sleep on the tri-fold sofa that extends to a 54' x 70' bed at night. The theater seating sits directly across from the 50' articulating TV for movie nights, and the pantry with drawers is right next to the theater seating for quick access to snacks! The chef of your group is sure to love the kitchen with its ample counter space, 30' residential microwave, and a sliding dining table with a drawer for even more storage. The desk in the back will allow you to get some work done if needed, or you can just spend your days outdoors under the two power awnings. There is also an exterior 12V refrigerator and storage, exterior speakers and controls, and a pass-thru storage for camp gear! The Brinkley mid-profile Model Z fifth wheels bring you clean lines and an upscale look with plenty of style and exciting new features like the industry first brass plumbing connections. These units also feature an automotive grade front cap, plenty of exterior storage, dual exterior hot and cold showers, and wide stance leveling jacks for easy set up. Residential frameless windows provide a clean look and beautiful views, and ample electrical outlets and USB/USB-C outlets allow all of your electronics and appliances to easily be used and charged.
